steps.subject: Change of plans
steps.body:
Hi,

A small change of plans: your start date has moved to tomorrow, 9:00 AM. The Payments team is short-handed and would love to have you as soon as possible.

Please bring one piece of government ID and your signed offer letter. When you arrive, ask for Priya at reception and she will walk you in.

See you tomorrow,
The Maplepay People Team
